title: Schematicannon
description: The schematicannon is already an extremely useful tool in the Create arsenal, but... did you know it has a "hidden" trait?
Blocks placed by this machine do not cause adjacent blocks to update, giving you mountains of possibilites like:
-Changing out the obsidian in a Nether portal
-Placing blocks that need a special environment (placing flowers or azalea bushes on top of stone, etc.)
